mode_notes.FLAT_EXACT: overwrite a mid-window advancing segment with an exact constant; marked synthetic
mode_notes.LARGE_GAP: delay later samples to create a 500 ms source hole; no interpolation
mode_notes.REPUBLICATION_TO_FREEZE: one isolated republication then extend the hold across the freeze bound
mode_notes.SOURCE_FREEZE: republish one existing source sample for 1000 ms of receive time
mode_notes.STALE_SOURCE: attach phase_age_ms=500 on a mid-window segment

synthetic_gap_ms.reason: Roadmap names synthetic gaps on the order of 0.5 s. Detection remains the inherited 400 ms M-N4 floor.
